[Question]
After Xiao Li counts, how many parrots does he guess there are?

[Candidate Answers]
A. After counting, Xiao Li guesses there are 15 parrots.
B. After counting, Xiao Li guesses there are 38 parrots.
C. After counting, Xiao Li guesses there are 45 parrots.
D. After counting, Xiao Li guesses there are 35 parrots.
